segments.text: Day two of 100 Days of Machine Learning: the three types of machine learning.
segments.caption: Day 2 of 100 Days of Machine Learning: the 3 types of machine learning.

segments.text: Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement: how each one learns, where it's used, and how to pick the right one.
segments.caption: Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement: how each one learns, where it's used, and how to pick the right one.

segments.text: Three jobs. Predict the price of a flat. Split a shop's customers into groups. Teach a robot dog to walk.
segments.caption: Three jobs. Predict the price of a flat. Split a shop's customers into groups. Teach a robot dog to walk.

segments.text: Each one learns in a completely different way.
segments.caption: Each one learns in a completely different way.

segments.text: By the end, you'll match them instantly.
segments.caption: By the end, you'll match them instantly.

segments.text: Type one: supervised learning. It learns from examples that come with the right answers, like practising with a solved question paper.
segments.caption: Type one: supervised learning. It learns from examples that come with the right answers, like practising with a solved question paper.

segments.text: Take past flat sales. Each row has the area, the bedrooms and the location. Those are the features.
segments.caption: Take past flat sales. Each row has the area, the bedrooms and the location. Those are the features.

segments.text: And each row has the price it actually sold for. That's the label: the answer.
segments.caption: And each row has the price it actually sold for. That's the label: the answer.

segments.text: The model studies thousands of rows, and learns how the features lead to the price.
segments.caption: The model studies thousands of rows, and learns how the features lead to the price.

segments.text: Supervised learning comes in two flavours.
segments.caption: Supervised learning comes in two flavours.

segments.text: If the answer is a number, like a price in lakhs, it's called regression.
segments.caption: If the answer is a number, like a price in lakhs, it's called regression.

segments.text: If the answer is a category, like spam or not spam, it's called classification.
segments.caption: If the answer is a category, like spam or not spam, it's called classification.

segments.text: So yesterday's poll? Fraud or not fraud, learned from labelled transactions. That's supervised classification.
segments.caption: So yesterday's poll? Fraud or not fraud, learned from labelled transactions. That's supervised classification.

segments.text: The catch? Labels are expensive. Someone has to tag every email, every scan, every transaction.
segments.caption: The catch? Labels are expensive. Someone has to tag every email, every scan, every transaction.

segments.text: Type two: unsupervised learning. No answers at all. The machine finds the structure on its own.
segments.caption: Type two: unsupervised learning. No answers at all. The machine finds the structure on its own.

segments.text: Plot a shop's customers by how often they visit, and how much they spend.
segments.caption: Plot a shop's customers by how often they visit, and how much they spend.

segments.text: The machine spots three groups: bargain hunters, loyal regulars, and big spenders.
segments.caption: The machine spots three groups: bargain hunters, loyal regulars, and big spenders.

segments.text: Nobody named those groups. It found them. This is called clustering.
segments.caption: Nobody named those groups. It found them. This is called clustering.

segments.text: Unsupervised learning also flags the odd one out, like a card payment at three a.m.. That's anomaly detection.
segments.caption: Unsupervised learning also flags the odd one out, like a card payment at three a.m.. That's anomaly detection.

segments.text: And it finds what goes together: people who buy bread often buy butter too.
segments.caption: And it finds what goes together: people who buy bread often buy butter too.

segments.text: Type three: reinforcement learning. No answer key, and no fixed dataset. An agent learns by doing.
segments.caption: Type three: reinforcement learning. No answer key, and no fixed dataset. An agent learns by doing.

segments.text: The robot dog takes an action. The world answers with a reward or a penalty. A step forward: plus one. Falling over: minus ten.
segments.caption: The robot dog takes an action. The world answers with a reward or a penalty. A step forward: plus one. Falling over: minus ten.

segments.text: It tries thousands of times, and slowly learns the moves that earn the most reward.
segments.caption: It tries thousands of times, and slowly learns the moves that earn the most reward.

segments.text: That's how a machine beat the world champion at Go, and it helps fine-tune chatbots like Chat G P T.
segments.caption: That's how a machine beat the world champion at Go, and it helps fine-tune chatbots like ChatGPT.

segments.text: So here's the cheat sheet.
segments.caption: So here's the cheat sheet.

segments.text: Have the right answers? Supervised: it predicts.
segments.caption: Have the right answers? Supervised: it predicts.

segments.text: No answers? Unsupervised: it finds patterns.
segments.caption: No answers? Unsupervised: it finds patterns.

segments.text: Learning by trial and reward? Reinforcement: it learns actions.
segments.caption: Learning by trial and reward? Reinforcement: it learns actions.

segments.text: Save this. You'll use it for all 100 days.
segments.caption: Save this. You'll use it for all 100 days.

segments.text: Back to our three jobs.
segments.caption: Back to our three jobs.

segments.text: The flat price is supervised regression. The customer groups are unsupervised clustering. And the walking robot dog is reinforcement learning.
segments.caption: The flat price is supervised regression. The customer groups are unsupervised clustering. And the walking robot dog is reinforcement learning.
